blocks.text: SCHEDULE: Gilas Pilipinas at Fiba World Cup Asian Qualifiers Window 5 MANILA, Philippines–The return of Quentin Millora-Brown to Gilas Pilipinas duties for the fifth window of the Fiba World Cup 2027 Asian Qualifiers coincides with the dawning of a new era, with both June Mar Fajardo and Japeth Aguilar no longer around to man the middle. After skipping the last two windows after undergoing back surgery, Millora-Brown is back to provide more ceiling to a Gilas roster that already has Kai Sotto, AJ Edu and naturalized player Bennie Boatwright.
